title: Queen Mary Postcard Long Beach California Mike Roberts B2174 Lifeboats Unposted
condition_description: Unposted and unwritten. Deckle edges. Light toning on the back, small soft corner at the top left. See photos.
description:
Official Queen Mary Souvenir postcard, City of Long Beach, California. Published by Mike Roberts, Berkeley ("the Continental card"), card no. B2174, circa 1970s.

Front: the Queen Mary's clean white side and famous three red-and-black stacks, looking down the row of portside lifeboats toward the docking bridge.

Unposted and blank on the back. Deckle (scalloped) edges, light toning on the back. See photos.

Ships flat with a stiffener in a protective mailer.
